propositions: Container restart during in-flight review causes premature drain timeout (45s vs 1200s review timeout), triggering teardown-corrupted fail-closed -1 vote that blocks automatic reconciler recovery
Transient git-fetch hangs (>300s) in adapter.py are converted to BLOCK decisions with vote-bearing coverage-gap tags, which reconciler then treats as 'already voted' and never retries
Shutdown drain must be sized to full review timeout (1200s) and stop_grace_period adjusted to 1320s to allow in-flight reviews to complete before container termination

Retryable failures (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) must defer as vote-less with REVIEW_RETRY_DEFERRED marker to re-enable backfill reconciler, leaving changes eligible for automatic re-drive
Terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) must continue casting fail-closed -1 votes; only infrastructure/teardown paths vote-less

Bounded escalation: after N consecutive retryable failures on same (change_id, revision), cast -1 with retries-exhausted note and emit VOTER_ERROR; review_attempts table tracks and resets per-revision attempt count
